introduction: Legal Aid of North Carolina offers civil legal assistance and a JusticeHub application portal. Intake does not guarantee representation.
description: Legal Aid of North Carolina offers civil legal assistance and a JusticeHub application portal. Intake does not guarantee representation.

sections.who: Eligibility and case capacity are screened. Dedicated helplines serve some specialized needs.
sections.get: JusticeHub supports applications, secure messages, document uploads and case updates. Accepted cases may receive legal help.
